title: Check catalogue
description: The one machine-readable source of check metadata: every check the audit can report, in one ID namespace, with its method, requirements and playbooks. Engine checks and agent-only checks sit side by side. Rules a schema cannot express, such as agreement with the engine and the spec, are tested; see SCHEMA.md and the catalogue page of the docs.

catalogue_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Bump MINOR when a check is added, removed or renumbered, or when a check's phase, severity, scored flag, method or requirement IDs change. Bump PATCH for a title, playbook or rubric wording change that leaves every verdict meaning the same. Bump MAJOR at 1.0. Reports record it as provenance.catalogue_version.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256, first 16 hex digits, over one line per check, `id|phase|severity|scored|method|req_ids|engine_id`, with scored as 0 or 1, req_ids sorted and joined by commas, and a null engine_id empty. It changes with anything that bumps MINOR, so a test fails until the version and the fingerprint are updated together.

families.description: Each check family's full name, in the order the checks first use the family: the name a report or a chat message prints beside the family code. It matches the `# <name> (<FAMILY>)` heading of the family's file in `audit/checks/`; a test holds the two together.

id.description: The family, a hyphen and two digits. One namespace for engine and agent-only checks.

scored.description: Whether the check enters the Phase-1 score. False for informational checks, emitters, and checks the engine cannot evaluate yet.

method.description: automated: the engine decides. agent: a model decides, with cited evidence. Requirements verified by a person or by declaration have no check.

status.description: For an engine check, the engine's own status. For an agent-only check, planned until its rubric exists. An unimplemented or blocked check is reported UNKNOWN.

req_ids.description: The requirements this check verifies. The requirement's Checks field in spec/readiness-requirements.md says the same.

engine_id.description: The engine's ID for this check, which is the check's own ID; null for an agent-only check.

since_ruleset.description: The engine ruleset revision that added this engine check; set for checks added after ruleset 2026-11-06.1. When an engine report from an older ruleset lacks the check, report.py import-engine records it as UNKNOWN, so the draft can still be finished. Absent for older checks and for agent-only checks.

playbooks.description: The playbooks that remediate this check's findings. A playbook may be named before it is written.
